Alex —

Following up from our call this morning. To keep procurement moving and avoid a last-minute legal snag, I sketched a short sequencing checklist and a proposed MAP that ties the evaluation milestones to contract signoff. High level:

- Week 0 (now): finalize evaluation scope and billing contact for order form.
- Week 1: legal runs MSA/DPA redlines in parallel with procurement review of the order form.
- Week 2: internal exec approvals and PO submission (if needed).
- Week 3: sign; onboarding kickoff within 48 hours after signature.

Can you confirm: 1) procurement's required PO terms (net30, billing contact), and 2) whether your security team needs a separate evidence packet (we can package SOC2 and network diagrams).

I attached a basic MAP (MAP-Lumina-v2.xlsx) and a first-pass order form for your review. If procurement wants a DocuSign flow, we can prep that once redlines land.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync if helpful.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

If legal wants to carve out anything special in the DPA about logs retention (Lumina is in healthcare), flag that now — likely to be a minor addendum.

Diego
